assumptions.message: Added nextWateringDate (type date) to Plant to track when the plant next needs water and enable dashboard period filtering for plants needing water today.
Modeled 'photo note' as a text field photoNote on Plant for optional notes or photo references as described in the requirement.
Added createdAt timestamp to Plant for record ordering and audit.
Added createdAt timestamp to Watering for chronological logging and sorting.
Used wateredAt (type date) for the date the plant was watered, defaulting to today.
Declared custom operation plant.listDue (GET /plants/due) to list plants due or overdue for watering based on wateringIntervalDays and historical waterings.
Provided scientific species names (Monstera deliciosa, Ocimum basilicum, Nephrolepis exaltata) for the three seeded plants named in the requirement.
Omitted Watering from sidebar navigation as it is a log entity accessed directly from the Plant detail screen per outline guidelines.
Selected cards layout style for Plant list to facilitate quick visual scanning of houseplant care cards.

unresolved.message: Should deleting a plant permanently delete all associated watering logs (CASCADE), or should watering history be retained/archived?
Should the watering interval support seasonal schedules (e.g. less frequent watering in winter vs summer)?
Should photoNote support direct image file uploads (type image) in addition to or instead of text notes in future iterations?
Should multiple watering records for the same plant on the same date be permitted or restricted?
